name: Chat question
purpose: Shows a question the user asked GOV.UK Chat, in a dark blue bubble at the right of the conversation.

origin.notes: ChatCellView's question: Body in white on fills.surfaceChatQuestion, padded 16pt, its corners rounded 18pt. It is only as wide as its text, at the right, leaving at least 20% of the window to its left. The Android app's Question is the same, but leaves 60dp.

inputs.content: The question, as text, as the user typed it.

rules: Use it in a screen of GOV.UK Chat, after the answer before it, or after the welcome message for the first question.
Follow it with the answer, or with a chat loading while the answer is being generated.
Write the question as a user would type it: in their words, not GOV.UK's.

avoid.when: For GOV.UK Chat's answer, or its welcome message
For a question the user hasn't asked yet, suggested to them

references.description: A question between the welcome message and its answer, in light mode

examples.name: A longer question
examples.html: <govuk-app-chat-question>I’m moving to Spain next year. Do I need to exchange my driving licence, and how long do I have to do it?</govuk-app-chat-question>
